description:
Three Bikes in One — Built to Grow With Your Child
What sets the Dynacraft Bluey 3-in-1 apart is its ability to evolve alongside your child's development. In Stage 1, the telescoping parent handle extends to give you full steering control and guidance while your toddler gets comfortable on the bike and builds early confidence. As they gain their footing, remove the handle and let them take the reins in Stage 2 — pedaling independently on a classic tricycle. When they're ready to take the next big step, fold up the pedals and store them right on the frame to convert to Stage 3: a balance bike that teaches steering, coordination, and the core skills they'll need before graduating to a two-wheeler. No tools needed, no extra parts to lose — every transition is built right into the bike.
